subject: DI03005041

body.en:
Definition

A dye is a colouring substance which can be applied from a suitable medium and retained on a substrate by affinity, chemical bonding or a specific application mechanism. A chromophore is the colour-producing/conjugated structural group; an auxochrome modifies colour, solubility or substrate interaction. A pigment is normally an insoluble particulate colourant held by a binder or dispersion rather than applied by the same dissolved-dye mechanism.

Requirements and uses

A useful dye needs suitable shade, strength, solubility/application behaviour, substrate affinity and fastness to the required light, wash, rubbing and chemical exposure. Uses include textiles, leather, paper and specialised inks; food, cosmetic and pharmaceutical colourants need specific regulatory approval. Not every industrial dye is permitted in products contacting food or skin.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Suitable mediumમાંથી substrate પર affinity, chemical bonding અથવા specific application mechanismથી લાગીને ટકી રહેતો colouring substance એટલે dye. Chromophore colour-producing/conjugated structural group છે; auxochrome colour, solubility અથવા substrate interaction બદલે છે. Pigment સામાન્ય રીતે insoluble particulate colourant છે,જે binder/dispersionથી ટકે છે; તેની mechanism dissolved dye જેવી જ નથી.

જરૂરી ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો

Useful dye માટે યોગ્ય shade, strength, solubility/application behaviour, substrate affinity તથા light, washing, rubbing/chemicals સામે જરૂરી fastness જોઈએ. Textiles, leather, paper તથા specialised inksમાં ઉપયોગ; food, cosmetic/pharmaceutical colourantsને specific approval જોઈએ. દરેક industrial dye food/skin-contact productમાં માન્ય નથી.

body.en:
By chemical constitution

Azo dyes contain the–N=N–group; anthraquinone dyes use an anthraquinone-derived chromophoric system; indigoid dyes include indigo; other classes include triphenylmethane and phthalocyanine dyes. Natural/synthetic is an origin classification, not a chromophore classification.

By application method

Acid dyes:commonly applied to wool/nylon from acidic baths. Basic/cationic dyes:used for suitable anionic sites, such as many acrylic fibres. Direct dyes:have substantivity for cellulose. Reactive dyes:form covalent bonds with suitable fibre groups. Disperse dyes:low-water-solubility dyes for hydrophobic fibres such as polyester. Vat dyes:insoluble dyes reduced to soluble leuco form for application, then oxidised back inside/on the fibre. Sulphur dyes and mordant dyes use their own application chemistry. A dye may belong to one chemical class and another application class simultaneously.

Manufacture versus dye application

Manufacture synthesises and purifies the dye molecule; dyeing applies the already manufactured dye to a substrate. A vatting/reduction tank alone is therefore not a complete vat-dye manufacturing flowsheet. The following sheets manufacture nitrobenzene, aniline, anthraquinone, a representative vat dye and indigo as required by the syllabus.
body.gu:
Chemical constitution મુજબ

Azo dyesમાં–N=N–group છે; anthraquinone dyes anthraquinone-derived chromophoric system ધરાવે છે; indigoidમાં indigo આવે છે; બીજા વર્ગોમાં triphenylmethane તથા phthalocyanine dyes છે. Natural/synthetic origin પ્રમાણે છે,chromophore પ્રમાણે નહીં.

Application method મુજબ

Acid dyes સામાન્ય રીતે wool/nylon પર acidic bathથી લાગુ થાય છે. Basic/cationic dyes suitable anionic sites,જેમ કે અનેક acrylic fibres માટે છે. Direct dyes cellulose પ્રત્યે substantivity ધરાવે છે. Reactive dyes fibre groups સાથે covalent bonds બનાવે છે. Disperse dyes low-water-solubility હોય છે અને polyester જેવા hydrophobic fibres માટે છે. Vat dyes insoluble હોય છે; soluble leuco formમાં reduce કરીને fibre પર લગાડ્યા પછી ફરી oxidise થાય છે. Sulphur તથા mordant dyesની પોતાની application chemistry છે. એક dye chemical તથા application બંને basesના અલગ વર્ગમાં હોઈ શકે.

Manufacture તથા Dye applicationનો ભેદ

Manufactureમાં dye molecule synthesize/purify થાય છે; dyeingમાં તૈયાર dye substrate પર લાગુ થાય છે. એટલે માત્ર vatting/reduction tankને vat-dye manufacturing flowsheet ગણવી નહીં. નીચે syllabus મુજબ nitrobenzene, aniline, anthraquinone, representative vat dye તથા indigoનું manufacture છે.

body.en:
Definition

Nitrobenzene, C6H5NO2,is an aromatic nitro compound manufactured here by controlled nitration of benzene.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Benzene and a nitric/sulphuric-acid nitrating system, plus approved washing media. Sulphuric acid promotes the nitrating species and water control; nitric acid supplies the nitro group.

C6H6 + HNO3 → C6H5NO2 + H2O.

Labelled syllabus flowsheet

1. Cooled nitration system—E01

A closed, agitated reaction system brings benzene and the nitrating medium into controlled contact. The exothermic electrophilic substitution replaces one ring hydrogen by–NO2. Heat removal and feed control limit temperature rise and unwanted higher nitration. This is a process description only; laboratory charging order, quantities and emergency procedures must come from the institution’s approved SOP.

2. Acid separation and product washing—E02–E04

Reaction effluent settles into an organic nitrobenzene-rich layer and an acid-rich layer. The organic stream is washed/neutralised under the approved process system to remove dissolved acids; subsequent phase separation removes contaminated wash water. The acid phase does not proceed with the final organic product, and the aqueous washes require treatment rather than drain disposal.

3. Distillation and acid-system recovery—E05–E07

Product distillation removes volatile/light material and heavier impurities to obtain the required nitrobenzene grade. Spent acid is routed to a suitable reconcentration/recovery system, which removes reaction water and restores a reusable acid stream where the plant chemistry permits. Fresh acid make-up and a controlled purge maintain composition; recycle is not a claim of complete nitric-acid regeneration.

Operating and engineering considerations

Control cooling, agitation, acid composition, benzene containment and phase separation. Prevent toxic skin/inhalation exposure and nitration runaway; no unsupervised preparation is appropriate.

Applications / uses

Primarily aniline manufacture; also selected chemical/dye intermediates. Nitrobenzene is toxic and can cause methaemoglobinaemia; do not present historical fragrance uses as a safe application.

વ્યાખ્યા

Benzeneના controlled nitrationથી બનતું aromatic nitro compound C6H5NO2 એટલે nitrobenzene.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

Benzene, nitric/sulphuric-acid nitrating system તથા approved washing media લેવાય છે. Sulphuric acid nitrating species/water controlમાં મદદ કરે છે; nitric acid nitro group આપે છે.

C6H6 + HNO3 → C6H5NO2 + H2O.

Syllabus મુજબ labelled flowsheet

1. Cooled nitration system—E01

Closed, agitated systemમાં benzene તથા nitrating medium controlled contactમાં આવે છે. Exothermic electrophilic substitutionમાં ringનું એક H,–NO2થી બદલાય છે. Heat removal તથા feed controlથી temperature rise/unwanted higher nitration અટકે છે. આ process description છે; laboratory charging order, quantities તથા emergency procedures approved institutional SOPમાંથી જ લેવા.

2. Acid separation તથા Product washing—E02–E04

Effluent settle થતાં organic nitrobenzene-rich તથા acid-rich layers બને છે. Organic streamમાંથી dissolved acids approved washing/neutralisationથી દૂર થાય છે; પછી phase separation contaminated wash water દૂર કરે છે. Acid phase final organic product સાથે આગળ નથી જતી; aqueous washesને drainમાં નહીં,treatmentમાં મોકલાય છે.

3. Distillation તથા Acid-system recovery—E05–E07

Product distillation volatile/light તથા heavy impurities દૂર કરીને જરૂરી nitrobenzene grade આપે છે. Spent acid suitable reconcentration/recoveryમાં જાય છે; reaction water દૂર થઈ plant chemistry મુજબ reusable acid stream મળે છે. Fresh acid make-up તથા purgeથી composition જળવાય છે; recycleનો અર્થ સંપૂર્ણ nitric-acid regeneration નથી.

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

Cooling, agitation, acid composition, benzene containment તથા phase separation નિયંત્રિત કરવા. Toxic skin/inhalation exposure તથા nitration runaway અટકાવવાં; unsupervised preparation યોગ્ય નથી.

ઉપયોગો

મુખ્યત્વે aniline manufacture તથા selected chemical/dye intermediates. Nitrobenzene toxic છે અને methaemoglobinaemia કરી શકે છે; historical fragrance usesને safe application માનવાં નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Aniline, C6H5NH2,is an aromatic primary amine obtained here by reducing nitrobenzene with hydrogen.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Purified nitrobenzene, hydrogen and a suitable industrial hydrogenation catalyst; this is not the iron/acid solids-generating route.

C6H5NO2 + 3H2 → C6H5NH2 + 2H2O.

Labelled syllabus flowsheet

1. Feed preparation and catalytic reduction—E01–E02

Nitrobenzene is vaporised/preheated for the selected catalytic route and brought into controlled contact with hydrogen over the catalyst. Reduction changes the nitro group to an amino group while retaining the aromatic ring. The strongly exothermic reaction requires heat management and suitable hydrogen availability to limit unwanted intermediates/by-products. Reactor conditions and catalyst selection are plant-specific.

2. Cooling, separation and hydrogen recycle—E03–E05/E08

Reactor effluent is cooled so aniline and reaction water condense. The gas/liquid separator removes unreacted hydrogen-containing gas; cleanup/compression returns usable hydrogen and a purge limits nonreactive/light components. The condensed liquid separates into water-rich and organic-rich streams. Reaction water is not a saleable aniline product and requires controlled treatment.

3. Aniline purification—E06–E07

The organic phase is distilled to remove residual water, unreacted nitrobenzene and suitable light/heavy impurities. Product is cooled and stored in compatible closed equipment to limit contamination and oxidation/discolouration. If iron/acid reduction were selected instead, the flowsheet would need iron-sludge separation and additional neutralisation; those operations cannot be silently substituted into this hydrogen-recycle drawing.

Operating and engineering considerations

Aniline is toxic by skin/inhalation exposure and can cause methaemoglobinaemia. Control hydrogen containment, catalyst hot spots, oxygen ingress and distillation purity.

Applications / uses

Dye intermediates, rubber-processing chemicals and polyurethane-chain intermediates such as MDI manufacture through further controlled chemistry.

Nitrobenzeneને hydrogenથી reduce કરીને બનતું aromatic primary amine C6H5NH2 એટલે aniline.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

Purified nitrobenzene, hydrogen તથા suitable industrial hydrogenation catalyst લેવાય છે; આ iron/acidથી solids બનતી route નથી.

C6H5NO2 + 3H2 → C6H5NH2 + 2H2O.

Syllabus મુજબ labelled flowsheet

1. Feed preparation તથા Catalytic reduction—E01–E02

Selected catalytic routeમાં nitrobenzene vaporise/preheat થઈ catalyst પર hydrogenના controlled contactમાં આવે છે. Reduction nitro groupને amino groupમાં ફેરવે છે અને aromatic ring જળવાય છે. Strongly exothermic reactionમાં heat management તથા યોગ્ય hydrogen availabilityથી unwanted intermediates/by-products ઓછાં રાખાય છે. Reactor conditions/catalyst plant-specific છે.

2. Cooling, separation તથા Hydrogen recycle—E03–E05/E08

Effluent cool થતાં aniline તથા reaction water condense થાય છે. Gas/liquid separator unreacted hydrogen-containing gas અલગ કરે છે; cleanup/compression પછી hydrogen પાછું જાય છે અને purge nonreactive/light components મર્યાદિત કરે છે. Condensed liquid water-rich તથા organic-rich streamsમાં જુદું પડે છે. Reaction water aniline product નથી; તેનું controlled treatment કરવું.

3. Aniline purification—E06–E07

Organic phase distil કરીને residual water, unreacted nitrobenzene તથા light/heavy impurities દૂર કરાય છે. Product compatible closed equipmentમાં cool/store થાય છે,જેથી contamination/oxidation/discolouration ઘટે. Iron/acid route પસંદ હોય તો iron-sludge separation તથા extra neutralisation જોઈએ; આ hydrogen-recycle drawingમાં તે operations જાણે સમાન હોય તેમ મૂકી શકાય નહીં.

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

Aniline skin/inhalationથી toxic છે અને methaemoglobinaemia કરી શકે છે. Hydrogen containment, catalyst hot spots, oxygen ingress તથા distillation purity નિયંત્રિત કરવાં.

ઉપયોગો

Dye intermediates, rubber-processing chemicals તથા આગળની controlled chemistryથી MDI જેવા polyurethane-chain intermediatesમાં ઉપયોગ.

body.en:
Definition

Anthraquinone is an aromatic diketone with the anthracene ring framework; the syllabus route builds it from phthalic anhydride through o-benzoylbenzoic acid.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Phthalic anhydride, benzene, AlCl3 Lewis-acid system, controlled hydrolysis medium and a suitable cyclising acid system.

C8H4O3 + C6H6 → C14H10O3(o-benzoylbenzoic acid); C14H10O3 → C14H8O2(anthraquinone) + H2O.

Labelled syllabus flowsheet

1. Friedel–Crafts acylation—E01

In a closed, agitated system, phthalic anhydride acylates benzene under Lewis-acid promotion to form a complex corresponding to o-benzoylbenzoic acid. AlCl3 strongly complexes with the product, so work-up and salt waste are important; it should not be imagined as a perfectly recycled trace catalyst. Controlled cooling and compatible construction contain the reactive system.

2. Hydrolysis, phase separation and intermediate recovery—E02–E04

Approved controlled work-up hydrolyses the reaction complex and releases the organic intermediate. Solvent/aqueous separation removes aluminium-containing salts and permits benzene recovery after suitable purification. o-Benzoylbenzoic acid is isolated/conditioned before ring closure. Hydrolysis is a distinct unit stage with substantial heat/waste considerations, not merely a filter for unchanged solid AlCl3.

3. Cyclisation and product finishing—E05–E08

A suitable strong-acid cyclisation/dehydration system closes the second fused ring and converts the intermediate to anthraquinone. Controlled work-up, filtration and washing separate product from acid/salt liquor. Drying/purification gives the required intermediate grade. This chemistry builds anthraquinone from phthalic anhydride; oxidising anthracene is a different raw-material route.

Operating and engineering considerations

Control acylation heat, benzene exposure, hydrolysis heat, acid corrosion and aluminium-salt effluent. The chemical intermediate must be identified as the ortho isomer before cyclisation.

Applications / uses

Intermediate for anthraquinone dyes and other synthesis; specialised derivatives serve additional industrial processes.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Anthracene ring framework ધરાવતું aromatic diketone anthraquinone છે; syllabus routeમાં phthalic anhydrideથી o-benzoylbenzoic acid મારફતે બને છે.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

Phthalic anhydride, benzene, AlCl3 Lewis-acid system, controlled hydrolysis medium તથા suitable cyclising acid system લેવાય છે.

C8H4O3 + C6H6 → C14H10O3(o-benzoylbenzoic acid); C14H10O3 → C14H8O2(anthraquinone) + H2O.

Syllabus મુજબ labelled flowsheet

1. Friedel–Crafts acylation—E01

Closed, agitated systemમાં Lewis-acid promotionથી phthalic anhydride benzeneનું acylation કરે છે અને o-benzoylbenzoic acidને અનુરૂપ complex બને છે. AlCl3 product સાથે strong complex બનાવે છે,એટલે work-up તથા salt waste મહત્વનાં છે; તેને સંપૂર્ણ recycled trace catalyst માનવો નહીં. Controlled cooling તથા compatible construction reactive systemને contain કરે છે.

2. Hydrolysis, phase separation તથા Intermediate recovery—E02–E04

Approved controlled work-up reaction complex hydrolyse કરીને organic intermediate મુક્ત કરે છે. Solvent/aqueous separationથી aluminium-containing salts જુદાં થાય છે અને purified benzene recover થઈ શકે છે. Ring closure પહેલાં o-benzoylbenzoic acid isolate/condition થાય છે. Hydrolysis અલગ heat/wasteવાળો stage છે; unchanged solid AlCl3નું સામાન્ય filtration નથી.

3. Cyclisation તથા Product finishing—E05–E08

Suitable strong-acid cyclisation/dehydrationથી બીજું fused ring બંધ થાય છે અને intermediate anthraquinoneમાં ફેરવાય છે. Controlled work-up, filtration તથા washingથી product acid/salt liquorથી જુદું પડે છે. Drying/purificationથી જરૂરી grade મળે છે. આ phthalic anhydrideથી anthraquinone બનાવવાની route છે; anthracene oxidation જુદી raw-material route છે.

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

Acylation heat, benzene exposure, hydrolysis heat, acid corrosion તથા aluminium-salt effluent નિયંત્રિત કરવાં. Cyclisation પહેલાં intermediateને ortho isomer તરીકે ઓળખવું જરૂરી છે.

ઉપયોગો

Anthraquinone dyes તથા અન્ય synthesis માટે intermediate; specialised derivativesના વધારાના industrial uses છે.

body.en:
Definition

Vat dyes are water-insoluble dyes applied through a soluble reduced leuco form; the manufacturing example selected here is the anthraquinone vat dye Indanthrone Blue.

Raw materials and reaction principle

2-Aminoanthraquinone, caustic alkali and the controlled oxidation/work-up system of the selected industrial route. No laboratory fusion charges or operating recipe are supplied.

2-Aminoanthraquinone undergoes oxidative coupling/ring formation to indanthrone; the real alkaline reaction network includes ionic/intermediate species, so it is not represented as one universal plant-feed equation.

Labelled syllabus flowsheet

1. Feed and controlled oxidative fusion—E01–E02

The identified2-aminoanthraquinone feed is conditioned for a purpose-designed alkaline fusion reactor. Under the selected industrial system, alkali and controlled oxidation promote coupling and ring formation to build the larger indanthrone chromophore. Temperature and mixing determine conversion and by-products; this is chemical dye synthesis, not merely reducing an already purchased vat dye for cloth application.

2. Controlled work-up and dye isolation—E03–E05

After reaction, the fusion mass is worked up by the approved industrial system to obtain a filterable dye suspension. Filtration separates crude dye from alkaline liquor; washing/purification removes salts and residual impurities. The work-up must manage the heat of dilution and chemical residues. Recovered liquor requires a specified reuse/treatment route rather than uncontrolled discharge.

3. Drying and formulation—E06–E08

Purified dye is dried, milled and formulated to controlled shade, strength and particle behaviour. The insoluble final product is packed as the vat-dye grade. In subsequent dyeing, it is reduced to leuco form, absorbed by the fibre and reoxidised; that application cycle follows manufacture and is not a substitute for the fusion/isolation train.

Operating and engineering considerations

Vat dye is a class, not one compound. Do not claim that all vat dyes are made from2-aminoanthraquinone, or that direct anthraquinone nitration automatically gives the required2-amino precursor. Strong alkali, oxidation and hot fusion require specialist industrial containment.

Applications / uses

Blue shades on suitable cellulosic textiles where high fastness is required; related pigment-grade uses depend on formulation and approval.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Soluble reduced leuco form દ્વારા લગાડાતા water-insoluble dyes એટલે vat dyes; અહીં manufacturing example તરીકે anthraquinone vat dye Indanthrone Blue પસંદ છે.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

2-Aminoanthraquinone, caustic alkali તથા selected industrial routeની controlled oxidation/work-up system લેવાય છે. Laboratory fusion charges અથવા operating recipe આપેલ નથી.

2-Aminoanthraquinone undergoes oxidative coupling/ring formation to indanthrone; the real alkaline reaction network includes ionic/intermediate species, so it is not represented as one universal plant-feed equation.

Syllabus મુજબ labelled flowsheet

1. Feed તથા Controlled oxidative fusion—E01–E02

ઓળખાયેલ2-aminoanthraquinoneને purpose-designed alkaline fusion reactor માટે condition કરાય છે. Selected industrial systemમાં alkali તથા controlled oxidationથી coupling/ring formation થઈ મોટું indanthrone chromophore બને છે. Temperature/mixing conversion તથા by-products નક્કી કરે છે; આ chemical dye synthesis છે,ખરીદેલા vat dyeને કપડાં માટે ફક્ત reduce કરવાની ક્રિયા નહીં.

2. Controlled work-up તથા Dye isolation—E03–E05

Reaction પછી fusion massનું approved industrial work-up કરીને filterable dye suspension બનાવાય છે. Filtration crude dyeને alkaline liquorથી જુદું કરે છે; washing/purification salts તથા impurities દૂર કરે છે. Dilution heat તથા chemical residuesનું management જરૂરી છે. Recovered liquor માટે specified reuse/treatment જોઈએ,uncontrolled discharge નહીં.

3. Drying તથા Formulation—E06–E08

Purified dye dry/mill/formulate કરીને controlled shade, strength તથા particle behaviour મેળવાય છે. Insoluble product vat-dye gradeમાં pack થાય છે. પછી dyeingમાં leuco formમાં reduce થઈ fibreમાં પ્રવેશે છે અને ફરી oxidise થાય છે; આ application cycle manufacture પછીનો છે,fusion/isolation trainનો વિકલ્પ નહીં.

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

body.en:
Definition

Indigo is a blue indigoid vat dye; this selected industrial Heumann/Pfleger-type route forms indoxyl from a phenylglycine intermediate and oxidises it to indigo.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Aniline, monochloroacetic-acid/neutralisation system, route-specific alkaline/amide cyclisation system, water and air. This is a route overview, not a laboratory fusion procedure.

C6H5NH2 + ClCH2COOH → C6H5NHCH2COOH + HCl(overall intermediate formation);2C8H7NO(indoxyl) + O2 → C16H10N2O2(indigo) + 2H2O.

Labelled syllabus flowsheet

1. Phenylglycine preparation—E01–E02

Controlled reaction of aniline with the monochloroacetic-acid system forms N-phenylglycine or its salt; neutralisation and intermediate conditioning remove/manage the associated salts and acidity. The intermediate must have the correct structure for subsequent ring closure. It is not identical to simply oxidising aniline to a blue product.

2. Alkaline cyclisation and work-up—E03–E04

The selected strong-base/amide industrial system cyclises phenylglycine to an indoxyl-type intermediate. Controlled work-up transfers it to a suitable solution for oxidation. Fusion chemistry, heat transfer and work-up are specialised operations; the schematic does not give safe quantities, addition order or conditions for student self-preparation.

3. Air oxidation and finishing—E05–E08

Air oxidation couples indoxyl units to form the conjugated, water-insoluble indigo dye. The blue solid is filtered and washed to remove soluble salts, then dried, milled and formulated. In textile application, the final indigo is later reduced to soluble leuco indigo and reoxidised on the fibre. Manufacturing oxidation and dye-bath reduction therefore occur at different stages with different purposes.

Operating and engineering considerations

Control precursor purity, cyclisation selectivity, air oxidation, filtration and salt removal. Do not confuse indigo dye manufacture with extraction from plants or the leuco vatting step.

Applications / uses

Denim and other suitable cotton/textile blue dyeing; grade and application method determine shade and fastness.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

Aniline, monochloroacetic-acid/neutralisation system, route-specific alkaline/amide cyclisation system, water તથા air લેવાય છે. આ route overview છે,laboratory fusion procedure નહીં.

1. Phenylglycine preparation—E01–E02

Aniline તથા monochloroacetic-acid systemની controlled reactionથી N-phenylglycine અથવા તેનું salt બને છે; neutralisation/conditioningથી acidity તથા salts manage થાય છે. આગળની ring closure માટે intermediateનું યોગ્ય structure જોઈએ. આ anilineને સીધું oxidise કરીને blue product મેળવવાની ક્રિયા નથી.

Selected strong-base/amide industrial system phenylglycineનું cyclisation કરીને indoxyl-type intermediate બનાવે છે. Controlled work-up તેને oxidation માટે suitable solutionમાં લાવે છે. Precursor purity, cyclisation selectivity, air oxidation, filtration તથા salt removal નિયંત્રિત કરવાં. Indigo manufactureને plant extraction અથવા leuco vatting સાથે ગૂંચવવું નહીં.

Denim તથા suitable cotton/textile blue dyeingમાં ઉપયોગ; grade/application methodથી shade તથા fastness નક્કી થાય છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Dyes—definition,requirements and applications.
q.gu: રંગો—વ્યાખ્યા,જરૂરી ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગોની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A dye is a colouring substance which can be applied from a suitable medium and retained on a substrate by affinity, chemical bonding or a specific application mechanism. A chromophore is the colour-producing/conjugated structural group; an auxochrome modifies colour, solubility or substrate interaction. A pigment is normally an insoluble particulate colourant held by a binder or dispersion rather than applied by the same dissolved-dye mechanism.
a.gu: Suitable mediumમાંથી substrate પર affinity, chemical bonding અથવા specific application mechanismથી લાગીને ટકી રહેતો colouring substance એટલે dye. Chromophore colour-producing/conjugated structural group છે; auxochrome colour, solubility અથવા substrate interaction બદલે છે. Pigment સામાન્ય રીતે insoluble particulate colourant છે,જે binder/dispersionથી ટકે છે; તેની mechanism dissolved dye જેવી જ નથી.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Classification of dyes.

a.en: Azo dyes contain the–N=N–group; anthraquinone dyes use an anthraquinone-derived chromophoric system; indigoid dyes include indigo; other classes include triphenylmethane and phthalocyanine dyes. Natural/synthetic is an origin classification, not a chromophore classification.
a.gu: Azo dyesમાં–N=N–group છે; anthraquinone dyes anthraquinone-derived chromophoric system ધરાવે છે; indigoidમાં indigo આવે છે; બીજા વર્ગોમાં triphenylmethane તથા phthalocyanine dyes છે. Natural/synthetic origin પ્રમાણે છે,chromophore પ્રમાણે નહીં.

a.en: Nitrobenzene, C6H5NO2,is an aromatic nitro compound manufactured here by controlled nitration of benzene.
a.gu: Benzeneના controlled nitrationથી બનતું aromatic nitro compound C6H5NO2 એટલે nitrobenzene.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Aniline from nitrobenzene.

a.en: Aniline, C6H5NH2,is an aromatic primary amine obtained here by reducing nitrobenzene with hydrogen.
a.gu: Nitrobenzeneને hydrogenથી reduce કરીને બનતું aromatic primary amine C6H5NH2 એટલે aniline.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Anthraquinone from phthalic anhydride.

a.en: Anthraquinone is an aromatic diketone with the anthracene ring framework; the syllabus route builds it from phthalic anhydride through o-benzoylbenzoic acid.
a.gu: Anthracene ring framework ધરાવતું aromatic diketone anthraquinone છે; syllabus routeમાં phthalic anhydrideથી o-benzoylbenzoic acid મારફતે બને છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Vat dye—Indanthrone Blue example.
q.gu: Vat Dye—Indanthrone Blueનું ઉદાહરણની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Vat dyes are water-insoluble dyes applied through a soluble reduced leuco form; the manufacturing example selected here is the anthraquinone vat dye Indanthrone Blue.
a.gu: Soluble reduced leuco form દ્વારા લગાડાતા water-insoluble dyes એટલે vat dyes; અહીં manufacturing example તરીકે anthraquinone vat dye Indanthrone Blue પસંદ છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Indigo dye.

a.en: Indigo is a blue indigoid vat dye; this selected industrial Heumann/Pfleger-type route forms indoxyl from a phenylglycine intermediate and oxidises it to indigo.
a.gu: Indigo blue indigoid vat dye છે; selected industrial Heumann/Pfleger-type routeમાં phenylglycine intermediateમાંથી indoxyl બને છે અને oxidationથી indigo મળે છે.

q.en: Define dye and distinguish a dye from a pigment;state applications and fastness requirements.
q.gu: Dyeની વ્યાખ્યા,pigmentથી ભેદ,applications તથા fastness requirements આપો.

q.en: Classify dyes by chemical constitution and application method with examples.
q.gu: Chemical constitution તથા application methodથી examples સાથે dyes classify કરો.

q.en: Explain nitrobenzene manufacture with acid separation and recovery.
q.gu: Acid separation/recovery સાથે nitrobenzene manufacture સમજાવો.

q.en: Explain aniline manufacture by nitrobenzene reduction using the selected catalytic route.
q.gu: Selected catalytic routeથી nitrobenzene reduction કરીને aniline manufacture સમજાવો.

q.en: Explain anthraquinone manufacture from phthalic anhydride through o-benzoylbenzoic acid.
q.gu: o-Benzoylbenzoic acid મારફતે phthalic anhydrideથી anthraquinone manufacture સમજાવો.

q.en: Explain manufacture of the representative vat dye Indanthrone Blue;distinguish manufacture from vatting.
q.gu: Representative vat dye Indanthrone Blueનું manufacture સમજાવો;manufacture તથા vattingનો ભેદ આપો.

q.en: Explain indigo manufacture through the phenylglycine/indoxyl route with oxidation and finishing.
q.gu: Phenylglycine/indoxyl routeથી oxidation તથા finishing સાથે indigo manufacture સમજાવો.
